{"source_id":"MS002-SRC-A","verdicts":[
{"claim_id":"CL-0326","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0525 and EV-0526 state feeding in a product as the initial step, using an already chosen influencer to represent it, and coming up with a bunch of short scripts around 150-200 characters.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0525","EV-0526"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0327","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0529 through EV-0531 cover the voice dump into Claude, the product image input, influencer image for the starting frame of a woman holding the product in a sensible environment, 10 script candidates under ~35 words for the time limit, showing the GPT-image-2 generated product image and scripts for verification, and adding more steps to become a skill.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0529","EV-0530","EV-0531"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0328","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0532 states manual verification worked, the intent to make it work digitally, feeding in the influencer and product, and that GPT image 2 can be called with the OpenAI API key in the local environment.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0532"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0329","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0533 says having verified manual usage, they need to verify it also through Claude, and then they will scale it.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0533"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0330","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0533 through EV-0536 give the brainstorming framing, 20-30 people of different geographies/ages/ICPs/personas pre-generated as images or videos, crossing by products and locations and scripts, and the 10 x 10 x 10 = 1,000 options example.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0533","EV-0534","EV-0535","EV-0536"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0331","judgment":"NOT_ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0536 supports 'just brainstorming' and 'not going to do anything as complicated as this because I don't want to put the cart before the horse,' but the referent 'this' is the 1,000-option cross-multiplication, not the automated filtering idea which is only described afterwards, so the claim's attribution to the automated filtering idea is unsupported.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0536"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0332","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0537 and EV-0538 describe the automated image check on ~10 second videos broken into 1 second frames, screenshots fed into an AI model like GPT or Claude Code, identifying anything malformed that doesn't make sense, and deleting it from the option set entirely.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0537","EV-0538"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0333","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0538 and EV-0539 state 250-500 remaining 10-second videos, 2500-5000 seconds of watch time, roughly 40 to 80 minutes, choosing the top 20 performers, and effectively replacing an entire creative department.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0538","EV-0539"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0334","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0540 states this is extraordinarily possible right now, very economical, and that you can test 20 with a small ad budget and figure out what makes the most sense to scale.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0540"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0335","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0542 and EV-0543 describe making Gemini Omni Flash accessible in Claude Code via the MCP and CLI feature, going to MCP and CLI, choosing cloud code, copying and pasting into the Claude Code instance, running it, and installing the Higgsfield CLI globally.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0542","EV-0543"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0336","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0543 and EV-0544 state that after installing a CLI and making it accessible to cloud code you have to log in, and that is how authentication is done.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0543","EV-0544"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0337","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0544 contrasts the previous inefficient way of getting the API key from Google/GPT image 2 directly and adding it to the environment with this being a simpler and easier way.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0544"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0338","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0545 states anytime there is a CLI option he would highly recommend it, that they save a tremendous amount of time and are a very easy and straightforward way of doing this.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0545"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0339","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0545 and EV-0546 describe the sign-in prompt, the authorization confirmation, it saying authenticated, the skills all installing, and having everything needed to actually use Higgsfield.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0545","EV-0546"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0340","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0547 and EV-0548 state taking the provided hero frame image as a start frame for the Gemini Omni Flash model set to 10-second total gen on a 16x9 aspect ratio.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0547","EV-0548"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0341","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0548 states ensuring the provided scripts are reasonably short so they fit in the whole 10-second gen.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0548"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0342","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0548 states every time he asks for this he'd like three candidate options generated.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0548"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0343","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0550 and EV-0551 state the first time will realistically take more trial than expected, take more credits, not be perfect, but over time it can be made cheaper and once consolidated as a skill you can go.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0550","EV-0551"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0344","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0553 and EV-0554 state you can parallelize these, three jobs A, B and C were sent simultaneously into the queue, and all three are grabbed once done and combined back into the output.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0553","EV-0554"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0345","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0554 states it will present the output to verify it did what he wanted, and once verified he will turn it into a skill.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0554"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0346","judgment":"NOT_ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0555 and EV-0559 support the script being too short for the 10-second video, weird results, and the woman having to repeat herself, but neither evidence says the model invented filler.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0555","EV-0559"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0347","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0557 shows the product physically disappearing/vanishing in a generated video and EV-0558 states this is the sort of thing you don't want to happen which is why you need some sort of Q&A.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0557","EV-0558"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0348","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0560 states making scripts and the video side shorter, e.g. candidate A could have been done in 8 seconds instead of 10, will also make them a lot more credit efficient.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0560"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0349","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0560 and EV-0561 state he should be able to simply say 'Generate me videos of this using the AI video generator product ad skill' and it should take the supplied products and influencer and turn that into a set.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0560","EV-0561"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0350","judgment":"NOT_ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0561 and EV-0562 list the pipeline steps but specify the video candidates at 16x9 with 8-second duration not 10, whereas the claim omits the duration qualifier and states only 16x9.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0561","EV-0562"]}
]}
